rule: R&A/USGA centre template (TPX3004). Driver, fairway wood, hybrid: the centre of the face perimeter, at the middles of its heel-toe and sole-crown chords through the point, iterated. Iron and wedge: heel-toe at the middle of the longest score line; up the face midway between the face's bottom edge and the top line there.
source: The population-average club of each category, drawn along the face normal in the kiosk face view (ui/src/components/panel/faceImpact.ts, faceCentre); docs/camera/impact-location.md gives the research aggregates. Method: official dimensions (blade lengths, lofts, lies) plus rectified OEM face-on photos; driver face heights from Golf Digest Japan lab measurements. ui/src/components/panel/faceCentreReference.test.ts fails when a drawing moves and this file is not updated.

fields.centre_from_toe_mm: how far the face centre sits heel-ward of the head's toe extreme, along the score lines
fields.centre_above_leading_edge_mm: the face centre's height along the face above the head's lowest point under it in the face-normal view: the physical leading edge, the datum the camera's sole line plus the sole datum lands on
fields.centre_above_face_bottom_mm: the same above the face's own bottom edge, for reference; the band between the two is the leading edge's radius seen face-on
fields.sigma: each *_sigma_mm is the population spread combined with the measurement error (docs/camera/impact-location.md), not a bracket around one model; impact_location.face_photo_reference passes them on for marked face photos. An unknown club takes the iron, its sigmas widened
fields.lowest_line_is_longest: whether the drawing's lowest score line (its row, end to end) is also its longest; when it is, a photo marking it marks the rule's own line
fields.centre_toeward_of_lowest_line_middle_mm: how far the face centre sits toe-ward (+) of the middle of the lowest score line, along the score lines; the lowest line is its whole row end to end, across any gap (the driver's two blocks)
fields.lowest_line_length_mm: that lowest line's length, end to end
fields.lowest_line_above_face_bottom_mm: the lowest score line's height along the face above the face's own bottom edge, under the centre
fields.club: the population the drawing averages: how many models, brands and years
fields.leading_edge_band_mm: the face bottom edge above the leading edge under the centre (centre_above_leading_edge_mm less centre_above_face_bottom_mm)
fields.centre_toeward_of_lowest_line_middle_sig: its spread; zero where the lowest line is the longest (the rule's own line)
fields.lowest_line_length_sigma_mm: the spread of the lowest line's length (the longest line's, scaled to it)
fields.lowest_line_above_face_bottom_sigma_mm: the spread of the lowest line's height above the face bottom
fields.longest_line_length_mm: the longest score line, end to end (an iron or wedge: the full-length lines the face centre sits on)
fields.toe_margin_mm: iron and wedge: the score lines' toe ends heel-ward of the toe extreme

driver.club: population mean of 12 face-on photos of 2021+ drivers from 6 brands (2024-2026 models), scaled by 121 lab-measured face heights from 15 brands, 2021-2026

fairway.club: population mean of 8 face-on photos of 2024-2026 3-woods from 6 brands, scaled by 7 published 3-wood face heights

hybrid.club: population mean of 8 face-on photos of 2024-2026 3-hybrids (18-19 degrees) from 6 brands, scaled by 5 published hybrid face heights

iron.club: population mean of 45 7-iron models from 10 brands, 2021+ (7 players blades, 23 players cavity/distance, 15 game improvement)

wedge.club: population mean of 19 sand and lob wedge models (54-60 degrees) from 8 brands, 2021+
